app.title: Spark: Sparklines in your shell
app.author: hskimse
app.description: A lightweight command‑line utility that generates ASCII sparklines for numeric data streams, intended for use directly in shell scripts and terminal dashboards.
proposed_tests: Install spark via git clone and make install, verify spark --help prints usage

Run `echo -e '10
20
30
40' | spark` and check output contains 4-character spark lines
Measure execution time for processing 100,000 numbers to benchmark throughput
Test integration with a simple shell script that pipes data into spark and displays result
